results.evidence: The hiking guide for the Dosewallips River Road puts the parking 8.5 mi from the highway, the washout at mile 1 of the walk, and the campground at road end 6.5 mi from the parking with a high point of 1,550 ft. So the 5.5-mile drive, the 5-mile and 11-mile road-walk figures and the 1,550-ft elevation on the parking pin are wrong.
